player_prompt.intro:
Sawubona ku-Frozen Lake!

Uyemekelwa 'P' esigridini.
Tibonjana tesigridi:
  ' ' = Sikwala sesikhala (kulungile ukugijima kuwo)
  'H' = Mgodu (wele ngaphakathi uwile!)
  'G' = Injongo (fikha kule ukunqoba!)
  'P' = Indawo yakho yamanje

Tinhlelo tinzima: phezulu, phansi, ekunene, ekusha (noma w, a, s, d)
Bhala tinhlelo takho njengesi: [up], [down], [left], [right] noma [w], [a], [s], [d]

Injongo: Khanyela ekuqaleni (phezulu ekunene) ukufikha kuleyo injongo (phansi ekusha) ungawezi wa wele emgodini!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tindzimo lesingekho mahlako. Utisa [up], [down], [left], [right] kanye na [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Kusetjentiswa '{action}'. Sebentisa up, down, left, right nobe w, a, s, d.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Uwele emgodzini! Umdlalo sewuphelile. Sewucedze {pct}% yeluhambo lolubangise egedeni.
outcome.turn_limit: Ufinyelele kumkhawulo wekugucuka! Umdlalo sewuphelile. Sewucedze {pct}% yeluhambo loluya emgomeni.
